findings.text: The success docstring promises that the rows are written, although `Database.table` can find a catalog entry with no row list at the target, in which case `Database.setRows` leaves the database unchanged. Fix: State that the step continues with `.done rows.length` and the database returned by `insertOutcome`.

The `unknownCounter` description allows the reason to name any unknown counter the statement reads, although `Counters.firstUnknown` selects the first one in read order. Fix: State that the run ends with the reason for the first unknown counter in `resolved.counterReads`.

The restatement of `StepCase.of_checks` calls the conclusion “the result of the two checks” without giving the result in either branch where a check fails. Fix: List the three results in order and state that only the `body value` branch requires evidence from `kind`.

The docstring says callers need uniqueness only at the statement’s clock value, although `kindUnique` requires it at every value, including when the statement has no clock value. Fix: State that callers must prove at most one related result for every integer clock value and that the proof uses this premise only in the `checked` branch.
